_설명: 천일문 3권 워크북 Chapter 12 특수 구문의 Chapter Test를 변형한 것. 심화 12과 특수구문 자리에 합쳐 둔다.

points.point: 장소를 나타내는 말이 앞에 오면 주어와 동사가 도치된다

questions.prompt: 다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것을 고르세요.
body: I don’t know about the new rule, and ________.

choices.text: so does Mina
so did Mina
neither does Mina
neither Mina does
neither did Mina

questions.prompt: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 생략할 수 있는 것을 모두 고르세요.

choices.text: Tell me first [[if you are]] ready to leave.
Mina always drinks warm milk [[when she is]] sleepy.
I wanted to order pizza but Jiho didn’t want [[to order it]].
Sora answered the question easily but I [[couldn’t answer]] it.
The children didn’t notice that it was dark [[while they were]] playing.

questions.prompt: 밑줄 친 부분을 강조하는 문장으로 바꿀 때 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 쓰세요.
body: Mina ran into Jiho [[at the library]] yesterday.
→ It ________________ Mina ran into Jiho yesterday.

questions.prompt: 밑줄 친 부분을 강조하는 문장으로 바꿀 때 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 쓰세요.
body: A loud noise from the street [[woke]] all of us up last night.
→ A loud noise from the street ________ ________ all of us up last night.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분이 어법상 알맞지 않은 것을 모두 고르세요.

choices.text: Jiho [[did look]] great in his new suit.
I [[do like]] spending time with my cousins.
The new drama’s poster [[do looks]] interesting.
Mina [[did wanted]] to buy new boots for the trip.
Everyone knows Sora and Minho [[do love]] each other.

questions.point_label: 강조 구문의 that과 가주어 It ~ that
questions.prompt: 다음 중 <보기>의 밑줄 친 부분과 쓰임이 다른 것을 고르세요.
body: <보기> It was my mother’s advice [[that]] helped me make the choice.

choices.text: It is this dictionary [[that]] I need for my report.
It was behind the door [[that]] I found my keys.
It is science [[that]] Mina likes most among all subjects.
It was surprising [[that]] the concert was canceled because of snow.
It was at her house [[that]] Sora held a party last month.

questions.prompt: 다음 질문에 대한 응답으로 알맞은 것을 고르세요.
body: Where did you go with Mina last weekend?

choices.text: I did go to the science museum with Mina last weekend.
It was Mina that I went to the science museum with last weekend.
It was last weekend that I went to the science museum with Mina.
It was I that went to the science museum with Mina last weekend.
It was the science museum that I went to with Mina last weekend.

questions.point_label: 장소를 앞에 두면 주어와 동사가 도치된다
questions.prompt: 주어진 문장을 밑줄 친 부분을 강조하는 문장으로 바꿔 쓰세요.
다음 중 주어진 우리말을 바르게 영작한 것을 고르세요.
body: 어떤 학생도 그 시험에서 떨어지지 않았다.

choices.text: Not all the students failed the exam.
Not every the students failed the exam.
None of the students failed the exam.
Not every the students didn’t fail the exam.
None of the students didn’t fail the exam.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 주어진 우리말을 바르게 영작한 것을 고르세요.
body: 역사상 가장 위대한 과학자인 Newton은 만유인력의 법칙을 발견했다.

choices.text: Newton, that is the greatest scientist in history, discovered the law of gravity.
Newton, is the greatest scientist in history, discovered the law of gravity.
Newton, which the greatest scientist is in history, discovered the law of gravity.
Newton, the greatest scientist is in history, discovered the law of gravity.
Newton, the greatest scientist in history, discovered the law of gravity.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분을 강조한 문장으로 어법상 알맞은 것을 고르세요.

choices.text: I told my brother [[the good news]]. → It was the good news what I told my brother.
[[Mina]] has left her wallet at home. → It was Mina which has left her wallet at home.
Sora had her hair dyed [[last week]]. → It was last week which Sora had her hair dyed.
Jiho bought [[a new tablet]] online today. → It was a new tablet who Jiho bought online today.
[[My dog]] chewed my new shoes as soon as I bought them. → It was my dog that chewed my new shoes as soon as I bought them.

questions.prompt: 우리말과 일치하도록 주어진 단어를 사용하여 문장을 완성하세요.
body: 지호는 이번 주말에 등산 가는 계획을 정말 좋아한다. (do, the plan, like, go hiking, of)
questions.answer: does like the plan of going hiking
